emotionalArc: From the overwhelm of not knowing where to begin, through five reassuring concrete moves, to the quiet confidence that starting is simple and the time is now.

transition.description: Open cold on warm paper; the title pins in word by word and a single seed drops to the lower center, setting up the growth motif.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Name the viewer's exact blocker and promise a simple five-part path out of it.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Starting to invest is just five concrete moves, beginning from zero.

scenes.script: Want to start investing but don't know step one? Here are five moves to begin.

transition.description: Title card slides off; three handwritten goal cards pin up in sequence with a timeline arrow drawing left to right beneath them.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Establish that a defined goal sets the whole plan's timeline before any money moves.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Naming your why — retirement, a home, freedom — sets your investing timeline.

scenes.script: First, name your goal. Retirement, a house, freedom — your why sets the timeline.

transition.description: On the same paper stage, a jar fills to a marked line while a frayed terracotta debt thread is cut; the seedling grows one notch taller.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Insist on financial stability as the precondition for investing at all.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Secure an emergency fund and clear high-interest debt before investing.

scenes.script: Next, secure the base: an emergency fund and no high-interest debt. Invest from stability.

transition.description: Same stage; three paper folders labeled 401(k), IRA and Brokerage fan out and a tax-advantaged tag stamps onto the first two with an ink press.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Show that the account wrapper, chosen before buying, determines the tax treatment.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Pick an account — 401(k), IRA, or brokerage — to set your tax break.

scenes.script: Then open an account — a 401(k), IRA, or brokerage. The wrapper decides your tax break.

transition.description: Punch into a single coin that fans out into a grid of tiny company tiles representing the whole market while a fee percentage counts down toward zero.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Present low-cost index funds as the simplest diversified way to actually invest.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Low-cost index funds buy the whole market at once with low fees.

scenes.script: Now invest. Low-cost index funds spread your money across the whole market in one buy.

transition.sharedMotif: the growing seedling becoming a tree
transition.description: Same stage; a monthly calendar drops a coin each cycle while the seedling grows into a full tree and a compounding curve rises behind it.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Convert the steps into a durable habit and credit time, not timing, for growth.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Automate a monthly amount and let time and compounding do the work.

scenes.script: Last, automate it. Invest a set amount monthly and let time do the heavy lifting.

transition.description: Dissolve to a tidy checklist as the five step cards re-pin in a vertical stack, each checkmark stamping down beside the grown tree.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Compress the five moves into one memorable, repeatable list.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Goal, safety net, account, index funds, automate — that is the whole start.

scenes.script: Goal, safety net, account, index funds, automate. Five steps — that's the whole start.

transition.description: Checklist slides away to leave the tree on paper beside a faint echo of the opening seed; the headline pins in and a small disclaimer fades up at the bottom.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Remove the last excuse and push the viewer to act today, with required disclaimer.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: The best moment to start is now — begin today.

scenes.script: The best time to start was yesterday. The second best is today. Start today.
